def solve3(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    noise={0,1,4} & set(cnt)
    regs=[]
    for c in cnt:
        if c in noise: continue
        rs=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if inp[i][j]==c]
        regs+= [(c,reg) for reg in regions(rs)]
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if inp[i][j] in noise:
                best=cnt.most_common()[-1]  # placeholder
                best=None
                for c,reg in regs:
                    if not reg: continue
                    rs=set(reg)|{(i,j)}
                    ia=min(a for a,b in rs); ib=min(b for a,b in rs)
                    xa=max(a for a,b in rs); xb=max(b for a,b in rs)
                    ba=min(a for a,b in reg); bb=min(b for a,b in reg)
                    sa=max(a for a,b in reg); sb=max(b for a,b in reg)
                    if (xa-ia+1)*(xb-ib+1)==len(rs) and (ia,ib,xa,xb)==(ba,bb,sa,sb):
                        best=c
                out[i][j]=best if best is not None else max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    return out
r3=solve3(inp)
print(r3==out, [(i,j,inp[i][j],out[i][j],r3[i][j]) for i in range(20) for j in range(15) if r3[i][j]!=out[i][j]])
